name: Resolve Next Decision
summary: Resolve the highest-impact open decision one evidence-backed choice at a time.
description: Select the most consequential unresolved decision, present a compact set of viable options and a recommendation, then record the answer before continuing. Use when a plan has several open choices.
risk_reason: This skill resolves the highest-impact open decision one evidence-backed choice at a time; it does not ask several decisions in one interaction.
refuses: It does not ask several decisions in one interaction.
It does not include options that violate known constraints merely to fill a list.
It does not record its recommendation as the user’s decision.

operational.latency_reason: The skill resolves the highest-impact open decision one evidence-backed choice at a time, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
